recipes.name: Chicken Kabsa
recipes.description: Saudi Arabia's national dish: chicken simmered in spiced tomato broth over caramelized-onion basmati rice.

ingredients.name: Kabsa Spice Mix
ingredients.note: cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, black lime, nutmeg

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces in ghee; set aside.
Sauté onions until golden; add garlic, tomatoes, paste and kabsa spices.
Return chicken, cover with water and simmer 25 minutes; remove chicken.
Cook rice in the seasoned broth until it absorbs fully.
Nestle chicken on the rice; brown under a grill; finish with almonds and raisins.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Saudi Chicken Kabsa Recipe | Famous Kabsa

recipes.name: Chicken Mandi
recipes.description: Smoked, spice-rubbed chicken over fragrant yellow rice - festive Gulf cooking at its most aromatic.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in yogurt, mandi spices, oil and salt for at least 1 hour.
Roast at 200°C for 40 minutes until bronzed.
Cook rice with onion, turmeric and stock; mound on a platter.
Place chicken on rice; smoke the platter under a dome with a hot charcoal briquette 5 minutes.

videos.videoTitle: Arabic Chicken Mandi Recipe | Saudi Style Mandi

recipes.name: Saleeg Hijazi
recipes.description: Hejazi comfort food: creamy short-grain rice cooked in chicken milk-broth, crowned with roast chicken.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken with cardamom until tender; strain and keep the broth.
Roast or grill the poached chicken until golden.
Simmer rice in broth plus milk until creamy and tender.
Spread rice on a tray, lay chicken on top, dot with butter and pine nuts.

videos.videoTitle: Saleeg Recipe - Saudi Rice Special Dish/Traditional Saudi Cuisine

recipes.name: Margoog
recipes.description: Thin dough rounds simmered in a spiced vegetable-chicken stew - Najd's beloved one-pot winter meal.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken with onion; add tomatoes, vegetables, loomi and spices with water.
Roll dough paper-thin; cut into rough squares.
Drop dough into the bubbling stew in batches, stirring to separate.
Cook 15-20 minutes until dough is tender and stew thickened.

videos.videoTitle: HOW TO COOK MARGOOG | CHICKEN MARGOOG RECIPE | SAUDI DISH | ARABIC FOOD

recipes.name: Beef Kabsa
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef shoulder takes the throne in this deeper-flavored version of the national dish.

steps.instruction: Sear beef in ghee; soften onions with spices.
Add tomatoes, black lime and water; simmer 75 minutes until tender.
Cook rice in the rich broth; adjust seasoning.
Serve rice topped with beef, garnished with raisins and almonds.

videos.videoTitle: Beef Kabsa Recipe – Authentic Middle Eastern Rice Dish Full of Flavor

recipes.name: Matazeez
recipes.description: Hand-rolled noodle discs cooked directly into a tomato-beef vegetable stew from central Arabia.

steps.instruction: Sear beef with onion and spices; add puree, vegetables and water; simmer 50 minutes.
Knead flour into a soft dough; rest 20 minutes.
Roll thin and pinch small discs straight into the simmering stew.
Cook 12 minutes until discs are tender; serve family-style.

recipes.name: Harees
recipes.description: Wheat berries beaten into silky submission with slow-cooked meat - Ramadan and wedding tables' honored guest.

steps.instruction: Boil beef with onion and cinnamon until falling-apart tender.
Shred meat; return to pot with drained wheat and its broth.
Simmer very low 2-3 hours, whisking occasionally until porridge-smooth.
Beat in ghee; season; serve drizzled with extra ghee and pepper.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Saudi Style Beef Harees | perfect Texture 👌🇸🇦

recipes.name: Beef Mashkhool
recipes.description: Riyadh-style spiced beef and rice pilaf finished with raisins and toasted almonds.

steps.instruction: Sear beef with onion; add tomato, spices and water; simmer 70 min.
Add rice to the broth; cook till absorbed.
Top with beef, raisins and almonds before serving.

videos.videoTitle: HOW TO COOK DELICIOUS MASHKOOL RICE [Arabic food]

recipes.name: Shorbat Adas
recipes.description: Golden lentil soup brightened with cumin and lemon - the Gulf's nightly Ramadan opener.

steps.instruction: Soften onion in olive oil; add carrot and potato.
Add lentils, cumin and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Blend smooth; loosen with water if needed.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with warm pita.

videos.videoTitle: SHURBA ADAS/ SHORBAT ADAS ARABIC DISH

recipes.name: Mujadara
recipes.description: Rice and lentils buried under mountains of sweet caramelized onions - humble, ancient, perfect.

steps.instruction: Fry onions slowly in plenty of oil until deeply caramelized; drain half for topping.
Parboil lentils 15 minutes; add rice, cumin, salt and water.
Fold in the remaining onions; steam covered until rice is done.
Rest 10 minutes; crown with reserved crispy onions.

videos.videoTitle: Mujadara Recipe - Rice with Lentils and Caramelised Onions - Middle Eastern Mujaddara

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
recipes.description: Herb-forward bulgur salad with tomato, mint and lemon, ubiquitous on Gulf mezze tables.

steps.instruction: Soak bulgur in lemon juice and a splash of water 20 minutes until tender.
Chop parsley and mint finely by hand - never in a processor.
Toss everything with oil, salt and more lemon to taste.
Chill 30 minutes before serving with romaine leaves.

videos.videoTitle: Tabbouleh Salad lemon, EVOO dressing, parsley, tomatoes, red onion, cucumber and bulgar wheat

recipes.name: Mutabbal
recipes.description: Fire-roasted eggplant whipped with tahini, yogurt and lemon - smoky, creamy mezze essential.

steps.instruction: Char eggplants over an open flame until skins are black and flesh collapsed.
Peel, drain briefly, then chop/mash the flesh coarsely.
Fold in tahini, yogurt, garlic, lemon and salt.
Serve swirled with olive oil and parsley.

recipes.name: Ma'amoul
recipes.description: Semolina cookies molded around date or walnut filling, dusted in powdered sugar for Eid mornings.

steps.instruction: Rub butter into semolina and sugar; rest overnight for best texture.
Work in yogurt and baking powder to a soft dough.
Enclose date paste balls inside dough; press into ma'amoul molds.
Bake at 180°C about 18 minutes until barely golden; dust generously once cool.

recipes.name: Aseeda
recipes.description: Honey-butter-drowned dough pudding - ancient Arabian comfort served warm from one communal bowl.

steps.instruction: Bring salted water to a boil; rain in flour while stirring hard.
Beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until a smooth thick ball forms.
Shape onto a plate with a crater in the center.
Fill the crater with melted honey-butter and eat communally.

videos.videoTitle: How to make Asida, Aseeda recipe/Arabic desserts

recipes.name: Mandi
recipes.description: Slow-smoked spiced beef over fragrant long-grain rice.

steps.instruction: Marinate beef overnight in baharat paste.
Smoke over charcoal in mandi pit or oven 160C 2.5 hrs.
Steam rice separately with saffron; rest beef on rice.

recipes.name: Meat Kabsa
recipes.description: Saudi national rice — allspice dried lime slow beef.

steps.instruction: Brown beef hard in ghee with whole spices.
Add water dried lime simmer 90 minutes.
Rice absorbs broth; steam; fried onions.

recipes.name: Jareesh
recipes.description: Cracked wheat porridge with slow-cooked beef — Hejazi feast.

steps.instruction: Boil beef till falling apart; shred fine.
Cook jareesh in broth with yogurt 45 min slow.
Ghee tarka; serve creamy with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Mathlooba
recipes.description: Upside-down layered rice-meat-potato showpiece.

steps.instruction: Layer potatoes then eggplant at pot base.
Add spiced mince layer then rice.
Cook base 20 min; flip dramatic onto platter.

recipes.name: Thareed Lahm
recipes.description: Beef-vegetable broth poured over crisp regag bread.

steps.instruction: Simmer beef and veg in turmeric broth.
Tear bread into serving bowl base.
Ladle broth over; bread softens.

recipes.name: Harees Lahm
recipes.description: Wheat-beef porridge pounded to silky smooth.

steps.instruction: Soak wheat overnight; boil with beef 3 hrs.
Beat with paddle till elastic smooth.
Ghee pools and cinnamon rain on top.

recipes.name: Bukhari Rice
recipes.description: Carrot-rice pilaf crowned with cumin-coriander beef strips.

steps.instruction: Shred carrots into rice water; cook fluffy.
Sear beef strips hot with bukhari spice.
Crown rice with beef and almond crunch.

recipes.name: Lahm Maroq
recipes.description: Beef stew thickened with tomato and dried lime.

steps.instruction: Brown beef; soften onions; tomato-fry.
Add water dried lime; simmer 90 min.
Serve with rice or shawarma bread.

recipes.name: Kebab Homrah
recipes.description: Minced-beef kebabs charred over open flame.

steps.instruction: Knead mince with spices firm.
Thread flat on skewers.
Charcoal grill 4 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Ishtah Lahm
recipes.description: Beef stew with tahini swirl — Jeddah comfort.

steps.instruction: Brown beef; stew with tomato till tender.
Tahini swirl at end; simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with rice or bread.

recipes.name: Madhbi Lahm
recipes.description: Flat-grilled marinated beef — Adeni street king.

steps.instruction: Pound flat; marinate 6 hours.
Grill direct flame 3 minutes per side.
Rest 5 min; slice thin against grain.

recipes.name: Lahm Machboos
recipes.description: Spiced beef basmati with vermicelli garnish.

steps.instruction: Simmer beef in baharat broth 60 min.
Rice absorbs strained broth.
Vermicelli-golden top; lemon served.

recipes.name: Riyash Lahm
recipes.description: Thin-pounded grilled beef chops Aden-style.

steps.instruction: Pound thin; rub paste deeply.
Grill scorching hot 2 minutes per side.
Lemon immediately; serve with salad.

recipes.name: Lahm Tamis
recipes.description: Hand-pulled beef noodles — slow-cooked heritage.

steps.instruction: Simmer beef broth rich.
Pull noodles by hand; drop in broth.
Cook 8 minutes; serve with fried onion.

recipes.name: Beef Shawarma Platter
recipes.description: Thin-sliced shawarma beef plate with tahini.

steps.instruction: Marinate 4 hours in spice blend.
Grill hot thin slices.
Plate with tahini salad pita.

recipes.name: Madhbi Dajaj
recipes.description: Flat-smashed grilled chicken — Adeni street star.

steps.instruction: Pound thighs flat; marinate 4 hours.
Grill blazing-hot 3 min per side.
Slice; serve with flatbread and garlic sauce.

recipes.name: Dajaj Mashwi
recipes.description: Whole charcoal-grilled chicken, Jeddah feast staple.

steps.instruction: Butterfly chicken flat; rub golden spices.
Grill indirect 35 minutes turning thrice.
Ghee glaze; rest; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Dajaj Matili
recipes.description: Boiled then grilled — juicy two-step chicken.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken in turmeric broth 25 min.
Rack-dry 10 minutes.
Grill high heat 8 minutes for char.

recipes.name: Shorba Dajaj
recipes.description: Spiced chicken-tomato soup — Ramadan essential.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; add tomato base; simmer 40 min.
Shred chicken; return to broth.
Baharat finish; lemon and mint on table.

recipes.name: Firkha Dajaj
recipes.description: Shredded-chicken rice pilaf — elegant family dinner.

steps.instruction: Cook rice with toasted vermicelli.
Top with shredded saffron-tinted chicken.
Fried almond scatter; ghee drizzle.

recipes.name: Kebab Dajaj
recipes.description: Yogurt-marinated charcoal chicken skewers.

steps.instruction: Thread chunks; marinate 2 hours minimum.
Charcoal grill 3 minutes per side.
Serve with garlic toum and bread.

recipes.name: Chicken Kabsa (Classic)
recipes.description: One-pot chicken-and-rice — KSA everyday classic.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; add kabsa spice and water.
Simmer till nearly cooked; add rice.
Steam rice with chicken on top; rest covered.

recipes.name: Dajaj Hanith
recipes.description: Oven-roasted spiced chicken Saudi Sunday roast.

steps.instruction: Score chicken; rub spice-oil paste generously.
Roast 190C basting every 20 min for 1 hour.
Rest; carve; serve with rice and salad.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Plate
recipes.description: Thin-sliced shawarma chicken platter.

steps.instruction: Layer thigh slices on spit or pan-fry hot.
Shave thin slices.
Plate with rice salad toum.

recipes.name: Dajaj Mahshi
recipes.description: Spiced rice-stuffed whole roasted chicken.

steps.instruction: Stuff chicken loosely with rice.
Roast 180C 1 hour 15 minutes covered.
Uncover last 15 for crisp skin; almond top.

recipes.name: Tashreeb Dajaj
recipes.description: Bread-soaked chicken broth — ultimate comfort.

steps.instruction: Cook chicken in turmeric broth till tender.
Tear bread into bowls.
Ladle broth and chicken over bread.

recipes.name: Moammar Dajaj
recipes.description: Rice-tomato stuffed chicken — Jeddah home style.

steps.instruction: Stuff chicken with tomato-rice mix.
Roast 180C 1 hour 15 minutes.
Baste every 20 min; rest; serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani KSA
recipes.description: Layered spiced rice and chicken — Hejazi festive.

steps.instruction: Cook chicken masala thick.
Layer parboiled rice over masala.
Seal dough or foil; dum 25 minutes low heat.

recipes.name: Dajaj Kebab Wrap
recipes.description: Street-food chicken kebab rolled in thin bread.

steps.instruction: Grill chicken strips with kebab spice.
Roll in bread with garlic sauce fries pickles.
Wrap foil; serve hot.

recipes.name: Haneeth Biryani
recipes.description: Slow-roasted haneeth chicken over layered biryani rice.

steps.instruction: Roast haneeth-style with hawaij spice 2 hrs.
Layer rice with saffron and fried onion.
Place chicken on rice; serve.

recipes.name: Ful Medames
recipes.description: Slow-stewed fava beans — Saudi breakfast bedrock.

steps.instruction: Slow-stew beans 3 hours till creamy.
Mash roughly; season garlic cumin.
Serve with lemon parsley and bread.

recipes.name: Falafel
recipes.description: Deep-fried chickpea balls — street-food icon.

steps.instruction: Process rough not smooth; chill 1 hour.
Form balls; fry 170C 4 minutes golden.
Serve with tahini and salad.

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.description: Silky tahini-chickpea dip — essentials.

steps.instruction: Blend hot chickpeas with tahini smooth.
Garlic lemon to taste.
Pool olive oil; paprika dust.

recipes.name: Fattoush
recipes.description: Sumac-dressed bread salad with crisp pita.

steps.instruction: Toss greens vegetables.
Dress sumac-heavy.
Add pita chips last minute crisp.

videos.videoTitle: The BEST Lebanese Fattoush Salad Recipe | Fresh, Crispy & Flavor Packed

recipes.name: Tamees Bread
recipes.description: Tandoor-baked giant flatbread — daily Saudi staple.

steps.instruction: Stretch dough thin oval.
Slap tandoor wall or hot steel.
Bake 3 minutes till charred bubbles.

recipes.name: Sambousa
recipes.description: Crispy fried pastry triangles — Ramadan essential.

steps.instruction: Fill wrappers triangle fold.
Deep fry 170C 3 minutes golden.
Drain; serve with chutney.

recipes.name: Mujadara (Classic)
recipes.description: Lentils and rice crowned with caramelized onion.

steps.instruction: Cook lentils half-done; add rice.
Caramelize onions deep golden-brown.
Top generously; olive oil drizzle.

recipes.name: Tabbouleh (Classic)
recipes.description: Parsley-dominant herb salad with fine bulgur.

steps.instruction: Soak bulgur soft; drain.
Toss parsley mint tomato.
Lemon-oil dressing generous.

recipes.name: Mushabbak
recipes.description: Deep-fried batter swirls with date syrup.

steps.instruction: Pipe batter spiral into hot oil.
Fry crisp 2 minutes golden.
Date syrup or tahini pour.

recipes.name: Bamia
recipes.description: Okra stewed in tomato — simple home comfort.

steps.instruction: Saute onion; add tomato.
Simmer okra 25 minutes till tender.
Cumin finish; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Foul Salad
recipes.description: Chopped fava bean salad with herbs and lemon.

steps.instruction: Chop vegetables rough.
Toss with fava beans.
Dress lemony cumin; serve room.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Jareesh
recipes.description: Cracked wheat porridge creamy dairy — Hejazi.

steps.instruction: Cook cracked wheat in water 45 min till soft.
Stir in yogurt continuously.
Ghee cinnamon top; serve warm.

recipes.name: Sahoon
recipes.description: Steamed semolina cake with cream or honey.

steps.instruction: Mix semolina yogurt rest 30 min.
Pour in ghee-greased tray.
Bake 180C 25 min; serve cream or honey.

recipes.name: Mashlooq
recipes.description: Grilled halloumi and vegetable plate.

steps.instruction: Grill halloumi golden both sides.
Grill vegetables charred.
Plate with zaatar and lemon.

recipes.name: Mutabbal (Classic)
recipes.description: Smoky eggplant-tahini dip — meze essential.

steps.instruction: Char eggplant skin; scoop flesh.
Blend smooth with tahini garlic.
Pool olive oil on top.

recipes.name: Luqaimat
recipes.description: Deep-fried dough balls drenched in date syrup.

steps.instruction: Ferment batter 30 minutes.
Drop small balls fry 170C 3 min golden.
Drench hot in date syrup.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Perfect Luqaimat: Golden, Crispy, and Easy Arabic Ramadan Dessert 😋

recipes.name: Kunafa
recipes.description: Shredded pastry cream cheese cake — Ramadan crown.

steps.instruction: Press buttered dough in pan base.
Layer cheese thick; cover more dough.
Bake 180C 20 min gold; flip; syrup shower.

videos.videoTitle: Knafeh, Kunafa, Bread Knafeh/  Easy and foolproof, Hadia's Lebanese Cuisine

recipes.name: Maamoul bil Tamr
recipes.description: Date-filled semolina cookies — Eid signature.

steps.instruction: Form semolina dough rest 1 hour.
Encase date filling in patterned mold.
Bake 180C 15 min; powdered sugar snow.

recipes.name: Basbousa
recipes.description: Semolina syrup cake — classic Gulf sweet.

steps.instruction: Mix semolina yogurt rest.
Pour tray; diamond cut; almond centers.
Bake 180C 30 min; hot syrup soak.

recipes.name: Kala Khosh
recipes.description: Roasted-flour walnut confection — old Riyadh.

steps.instruction: Brown flour in butter 10 minutes.
Add sugar cardamom off heat.
Fold in walnuts; press in tray; slice.

recipes.name: Shuwaida
recipes.description: Cinnamon-fried doughnuts rolled in sugar.

steps.instruction: Fry dough balls puffed golden 3 minutes.
Roll hot in cinnamon sugar.
Serve with honey dip.

recipes.name: Muhallabiya
recipes.description: Rosewater milk pudding — Gulf silky classic.

steps.instruction: Cook milk cornstarch stirring constantly.
Pour when thick; chill 3 hours minimum.
Rosewater top; pistachio scatter.

recipes.name: Aseeda Sharab
recipes.description: Sweet wheat porridge with ghee and dried fruit.

steps.instruction: Cook flour in water stirring thick.
Beat in ghee sugar until glossy.
Serve hot with cream and fruit.

recipes.name: Green Kabsa
recipes.description: Herb-coriander beef kabsa — lighter Hejazi variation.

steps.instruction: Brown beef with green paste.
Simmer with dried lime 60 minutes.
Rice absorbs green broth; steam.

recipes.name: Saleeg Dajaj
recipes.description: Creamy rice porridge topped with spiced chicken.

steps.instruction: Cook chicken in baharat broth; shred.
Cook rice in strained broth till porridge.
Top with shredded chicken; butter drizzle.

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Spiced red lentil soup — daily Saudi bowl.

steps.instruction: Saute vegetables; add lentils and water.
Simmer 25 min; blend smooth.
Cumin oil swirl; lemon squeeze.
